note: Deep official-source audit of released reproducibility resources; explicit dimension claims are recorded below.

code.note: Official Xiaomi-Robotics-1 repository includes post-training, deployment and benchmark evaluation code.

weights.note: Base and benchmark checkpoints are publicly released through official model collections.

dataset.note: The 100K+ hour pretraining corpus and full post-training mixture are not released as one public dataset; repository provides formats/examples for adaptation.

training.note: Post-training code is public, while the full original large-scale pretraining pipeline/data are not exposed as a complete reproducible package.

inference.note: Deployment/inference code is publicly available in the official repository.

evaluation.note: RoboCasa, RoboCasa365 and VLABench have repository evaluation guides/checkpoints; RoboDojo points to external official docs without a matched released checkpoint in the table.
